title: AWS Cloud Engineer
description: A deep, project-based roadmap for AWS Cloud Engineer: Operate AWS workloads with IAM, VPC, EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, monitoring, automation, security, and cost-aware delivery.

tree.name: Foundations and Core Concepts
tree.description: Establish a strong understanding of cloud computing principles, AWS global infrastructure, account management, and fundamental networking concepts essential for an AWS Cloud Engineer.

resources.title: What is Amazon Web Services? AWS Explained | Tutorial & Resources (Apna College)
What is Cloud Computing & How Does It Work? | Cloud Computing Explained (Traversy Media)

children.name: Introduction to Cloud Computing & AWS
children.description: Understand the definition, benefits, service models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), deployment models, and the value proposition of AWS in the cloud landscape.

resources.title: Introduction to Cloud Computing - AWS Training
What is Cloud Computing? - Explained with Animations
Cloud Computing Explained - AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.

children.name: AWS Global Infrastructure
children.description: Learn about AWS Regions, Availability Zones, Edge Locations, and how they contribute to high availability, fault tolerance, and low latency.

resources.title: AWS Global Infrastructure Explained - Regions, Availability Zones, Edge Locations

children.name: AWS Account Management & Billing
children.description: Master AWS account creation, root user best practices, AWS Organizations, consolidated billing, and basic cost management tools.

resources.title: Managing Your AWS Account and Billing
AWS Organizations Tutorial - Create and Manage Multiple AWS Accounts
AWS Cost Management: Billing, Budgets, Cost Explorer for Beginners

children.name: Networking Fundamentals
children.description: Acquire foundational knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, CIDR, subnets, routing, and common network protocols essential for configuring AWS networking.

children.name: Linux & Command Line Basics
children.description: Develop proficiency in Linux commands, shell scripting, and using the AWS Command Line Interface (CLI) for interacting with AWS services.

resources.title: Linux Command Line Tutorial For Beginners
Linux Shell Scripting Tutorial | Shell Scripting for Beginners

tree.name: Core AWS Services & Infrastructure
tree.description: Dive deep into the fundamental AWS services, learning their architecture, configuration, and best practices for building robust cloud infrastructure.

resources.title: AWS Tutorial For Beginners | AWS Full Course - Learn AWS In 10 Hours | AWS Training | Edureka (edureka!)

children.name: Identity and Access Management (IAM)
children.description: Understand IAM users, groups, roles, policies, multi-factor authentication, and apply least privilege principles for secure access control.

resources.title: AWS IAM Masterclass - AWS Identity and Access Management (Theory + Demos)

children.name: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
children.description: Configure custom VPCs, subnets, route tables, Internet Gateways, NAT Gateways, Security Groups, Network ACLs, and VPC Peering to build isolated network environments.

children.name: Compute Services: EC2, Elastic Load Balancing & Auto Scaling
children.description: Launch and manage EC2 instances, understand instance types, AMIs, EBS volumes. Configure Elastic Load Balancers (ALB, NLB, GWLB) for traffic distribution, and set up Auto Scaling Groups for elasticity and high availability.

resources.title: AWS EC2 Master Class - The Most Complete EC2 Course!

children.name: Elastic Load Balancing (ELB)
children.description: Understand and configure Application Load Balancers (ALB), Network Load Balancers (NLB), and Gateway Load Balancers (GWLB) for distributing incoming application traffic across multiple targets.

resources.title: Introduction to AWS Elastic Load Balancing
AWS ELB Tutorial - Application Load Balancer (ALB) Explained

children.name: Elastic Block Store (EBS)
children.description: Learn about different EBS volume types (gp2, gp3, io1, io2, st1, sc1), creating snapshots, managing volumes, and their use cases with EC2 instances.

resources.title: AWS EBS Explained | Elastic Block Store Tutorial

children.name: Storage Services: Object, File & Archive
children.description: Work with S3 buckets for highly durable object storage, manage object lifecycle, versioning, access control, and explore Glacier for cost-effective archiving. Learn about EFS and FSx for managed file systems.

resources.title: AWS S3 Tutorial for Beginners | Amazon S3 Simply Explained (Theory and Demo)

children.name: File Storage: EFS & FSx
children.description: Explore Amazon Elastic File System (EFS) for scalable NFS file storage for EC2 instances and AWS FSx for Windows File Server or Lustre for specialized file system needs.

resources.title: AWS FSx explained | Learn in 10 minutes

children.name: Database Services: Relational, NoSQL, Caching & Data Warehousing
children.description: Set up and manage relational databases with RDS (Multi-AZ, Read Replicas) and Aurora. Explore DynamoDB for NoSQL applications, ElastiCache for in-memory caching, and Redshift for analytical data warehousing.

children.name: Amazon Aurora
children.description: Understand Amazon Aurora, a MySQL and PostgreSQL-compatible relational database built for the cloud, offering high performance and availability.

children.name: Amazon ElastiCache
children.description: Implement in-memory caching solutions using Amazon ElastiCache (Redis and Memcached) to improve application performance and reduce database load.

resources.title: AWS ElastiCache Deep Dive for Redis and Memcached

children.name: Amazon Redshift
children.description: Explore Amazon Redshift, a fully managed, petabyte-scale data warehouse service, for complex analytical queries and business intelligence.

resources.title: AWS Redshift Explained: What is Amazon Redshift?

children.name: Serverless Computing: Lambda & API Gateway
children.description: Develop and deploy serverless functions using AWS Lambda, configure triggers, integrate with API Gateway, and understand serverless architectures.

resources.title: AWS API Gateway & Lambda Tutorial | Create a Serverless API

children.name: DNS & Traffic Management: Route 53
children.description: Utilize Amazon Route 53 for domain registration, various DNS record types, health checks, and advanced routing policies (e.g., Weighted, Latency, Failover).

resources.title: AWS Route 53 Tutorial | What is Route 53? A Practical Introduction

children.name: Infrastructure as Code (IaC): CloudFormation & Terraform
children.description: Learn to define, provision, and manage AWS infrastructure resources using AWS CloudFormation templates. Explore other industry-standard IaC tools like Terraform for multi-cloud and advanced deployments.

resources.title: Terraform Tutorial for Beginners - Full Course (2022)

children.name: Terraform for AWS
children.description: Master HashiCorp Terraform for defining, provisioning, and managing AWS infrastructure as code, covering providers, resources, data sources, and modules.

children.name: Containerization: ECR, ECS & EKS
children.description: Understand container fundamentals and deploy containerized applications using Amazon Elastic Container Registry (ECR) for image storage, Elastic Container Service (ECS) for orchestration, and Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) for Kubernetes deployments.

resources.title: AWS ECR, ECS, Fargate - Containers on AWS Explained

children.name: Messaging & Streaming: SQS, SNS & Kinesis
children.description: Implement asynchronous communication patterns using Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS) for message queues and Simple Notification Service (SNS) for pub/sub messaging. Explore Kinesis for real-time data streaming.

resources.title: AWS SQS, SNS, Kinesis Explained (Theory + Demos)

children.name: Content Delivery Network: CloudFront
children.description: Distribute web content globally with low latency using Amazon CloudFront, configuring distributions, origins, caching behaviors, and security features.

tree.name: Operations, Monitoring, & Automation
tree.description: Implement robust operational practices including monitoring, logging, automation, security, and cost optimization to maintain healthy and efficient AWS environments.

resources.title: AWS CloudWatch Tutorial for Beginners | Monitoring AWS Resources
AWS Systems Manager Tutorial | What is SSM? Run Command, Patch Manager, Session Manager

children.name: Observability & Monitoring: CloudWatch, CloudTrail & X-Ray
children.description: Configure CloudWatch for metrics, logs, and alarms. Utilize CloudTrail for auditing AWS API calls and AWS X-Ray for end-to-end tracing of distributed applications to gain deep operational insights.

resources.title: Monitoring, Logging, and Auditing on AWS: CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and X-Ray

children.name: Distributed Tracing: AWS X-Ray
children.description: Implement AWS X-Ray to analyze and debug production, distributed applications, providing insights into performance bottlenecks and service issues.

children.name: CI/CD with AWS Developer Tools
children.description: Build automated continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines using AWS CodeCommit, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, and CodePipeline.

resources.title: AWS DevOps CI/CD Pipeline from Scratch

children.name: Security Management & Compliance
children.description: Implement comprehensive security practices across AWS services. Leverage AWS security services for threat detection, configuration management, network protection, and managing encryption keys and secrets.

resources.title: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) - Full Course for Beginners
AWS Security Best Practices - The Ultimate Guide

children.name: Threat Detection & Configuration: GuardDuty, Security Hub & Config
children.description: Utilize Amazon GuardDuty for intelligent threat detection, AWS Security Hub for centralized security posture management, and AWS Config for continuous monitoring and compliance auditing of resource configurations.

resources.title: AWS GuardDuty, Security Hub & Config Explained

children.name: Network & Application Protection: WAF, Shield & Firewall Manager
children.description: Deploy AWS WAF (Web Application Firewall) to protect web applications from common web exploits, configure AWS Shield for DDoS protection, and manage security policies across accounts with Firewall Manager.

resources.title: AWS WAF Explained | What is a Web Application Firewall?
AWS WAF, Shield & Firewall Manager - AWS Security & Advanced Networking Part 15

children.name: Key & Secret Management: KMS & Secrets Manager
children.description: Securely manage cryptographic keys with AWS Key Management Service (KMS) and automate the rotation, management, and retrieval of database credentials, API keys, and other secrets with AWS Secrets Manager.

resources.title: AWS KMS - Key Management Service explained

children.name: Cost Management & Optimization
children.description: Learn to analyze and optimize AWS costs using services like Cost Explorer, AWS Budgets, Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, and Tagging strategies.

resources.title: AWS Cost Optimization: The Complete Guide

children.name: High Availability & Disaster Recovery
children.description: Design and implement highly available and disaster-resilient architectures using Multi-AZ deployments, backups, snapshots, and recovery strategies.

resources.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate Full Course (SAA-C03) - Free Training

children.name: Automation & Configuration Management: Python/Boto3 & SSM
children.description: Automate operational tasks using Python with Boto3 for programmatic interaction with AWS services. Leverage AWS Systems Manager (SSM) for instance management, patch management, and running automation documents across your fleet.

resources.title: Automate AWS with Python and Boto3

children.name: AWS Systems Manager (SSM)
children.description: Utilize AWS Systems Manager for operational insights, simplifying resource management, automating operational tasks, and maintaining security and compliance across your AWS infrastructure.

resources.title: AWS Systems Manager Explained (SSM) in 10 minutes

children.name: Troubleshooting & Incident Response
children.description: Develop skills to diagnose and resolve common AWS issues, understand incident response procedures, and utilize AWS diagnostic tools.

resources.title: AWS CloudWatch Deep Dive - Learn to Monitor Your AWS Infrastructure

tree.name: Project Work & Career Readiness
tree.description: Apply learned skills to real-world projects, build a strong portfolio, prepare for AWS certifications, and effectively position yourself for an AWS Cloud Engineer role.

resources.title: How to Get Started with AWS Cloud - A Cloud Engineer Roadmap
Become a Cloud Engineer - Roadmap & Guide

children.name: Project: Build a Scalable Web Application on AWS
children.description: Design and deploy a multi-tier web application using VPC, EC2, Auto Scaling, Load Balancer, RDS, S3, and implement CI/CD with AWS Developer Tools. Document the architecture, challenges, and solutions.

resources.title: Deploy a Scalable React App to AWS Elastic Beanstalk (freeCodeCamp.org)
AWS CI/CD Project - Deploy React App with CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy to S3 & CloudFront (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Project: Serverless Data Processing Pipeline
children.description: Create a serverless backend for data ingestion and processing using S3, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and CloudWatch for monitoring.

resources.title: Build a Serverless API with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB

children.name: Case Study & Documentation
children.description: Document your projects as concise case studies, detailing problems, chosen AWS services, architectural decisions, implementation steps, and outcomes.

resources.title: Crafting Effective Case Studies for Your Portfolio

children.name: AWS Certification Preparation
children.description: Prepare for relevant AWS certifications like AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate or AWS Certified SysOps Administrator - Associate to validate your skills.

resources.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate Course

children.name: Interview & Career Strategy
children.description: Develop interview skills, practice technical questions, and learn to articulate your AWS project experience effectively for Cloud Engineer roles.

resources.title: AWS Cloud Engineer Interview Questions and Answers
How to GET A CLOUD JOB (even with NO EXPERIENCE) | My Journey from Junior to Senior Cloud Engineer
